method: Primary-source claim verification, evidence retention, and targeted follow-up

claims.claim: The public Jev interface accepts text and emits typed probabilistic decisions.
claims.limit: Does not disclose a reproducible internal model or complete training recipe.

claims.claim: Joint patch/text interaction is a credible architecture pattern.
claims.limit: ViLT uses pretrained initialization; it does not validate our from-scratch small model.

claims.claim: A2 will outperform FiLM and latent fusion within the laptop budget.
claims.test: Compare A0-A3 at equal time, then confirm finalists with fresh seeds and longer runs.

claims.claim: Proper log/Brier objectives target probabilities whereas sampled correctness reward targets actions.
claims.limit: Finite learned models may remain miscalibrated; see the explicit binary derivation in README.

claims.claim: The proposed independent shared scorer is candidate-permutation equivariant.
conditions: No order-dependent truncation or cross-candidate attention
claims.test: Permutation and opaque-ID checks against the implemented model; tie-aware decision policy.

claims.claim: The model will use both modalities and generalize to unseen combinations.
claims.test: Balanced tasks, independently trained unimodal controls, counterfactual pairs, and held-out tuple/grammar slices.

claims.claim: AIDE2 reports transferable research-harness gains but its ignition test is inconclusive.
claims.limit: Very recent preprint; no local reproduction or independently verified replication.

claims.claim: Archive-based search will find better models per unit total cost than greedy search here.
claims.test: Separate matched-cost policy comparison on new task families; count proposer and evaluator costs.

claims.claim: ShinkaEvolve is compatible with the future local evaluator.
claims.test: Pin dependency revision and run a deterministic provider-free integration smoke test.

claims.claim: The proposed baseline meets a 100 ms warm p95 latency target.
claims.test: Pilot batch-one input-to-probability measurement including preprocessing and device synchronization.

claims.claim: Calibration remains useful under distribution shift.
claims.test: Measure raw and adjusted NLL, Brier, reliability, and accepted risk on each shifted slice.

claims.claim: Synthetic shape/text success establishes computer/browser-use ability.
claims.test: Require independent real speech, sound, screen, and paired decision evidence.

claims.claim: Native audio plus screenshot fusion improves useful decisions over ASR plus vision.
claims.test: Matched paired-task comparison including acoustic cues, unseen speakers/sites, complete input cost, and abstention.

claims.claim: Public unimodal datasets alone cover the intended joint audio-screen task.
claims.test: Collect semantically paired episodes requiring both modalities and audit coverage.

claims.claim: Small from-scratch speech CNN achieved 81.25% accuracy on 256 speaker-disjoint test records.
claims.limit: Eight keywords, one seed, one same-split exact duplicate pair; unique-media sensitivity is reported separately.

claims.claim: Small from-scratch sound CNN achieved 66.25% accuracy on 80 held-out source-fold clips.
claims.limit: Ten exclusive sound classes, not overlapping events or official five-fold CV.

claims.claim: Coarse-grid CLIP grounding hit 0/24 screen targets; only 1/24 is reachable by any candidate point.
claims.limit: Small disclosed external probe; supplied-crop type classification is separate.

claims.claim: A single jointly trained neural checkpoint consumes audio, pixels, question text, and candidate descriptions with a shared scalar answer scorer.
claims.limit: Eight recorded keywords, generated 2x2 panels, limited learned vocabulary; supervised learning, not a Jev-internals reproduction.

claims.claim: Both modalities contribute on the in-distribution paired task: 72.92% versus 50.00% audio-only and 49.83% image-only.
claims.limit: One seed; matched steps; speaker-cluster intervals condition on trained checkpoints.

claims.claim: The selected model generalizes to the held command-color pairs.
claims.limit: This exposed test must become development evidence for a later redesigned study.

claims.claim: The local developer API accepts native image/audio content and returns Choice, Noul, Score, and Ranking views using the pinned joint-v2 checkpoint.
claims.limit: Own API contract with content helpers, not full provider SDK compatibility; the checkpoint remains limited to eight keywords and generated panels.

claims.claim: The 2.42-times larger model improves compositional accuracy over the matched small model in the new study.
claims.limit: One seed, matched attempt steps but different selected checkpoint updates; paired fixed-checkpoint speaker interval includes zero.

claims.claim: The tested fixed shape/color visual prior improves final compositional decisions.
claims.limit: Renderer-specific pixel prior; paired interval includes zero; new checkpoints lose about twenty points of familiar-combination accuracy versus the served model.
